instruction: Guide me in switching the VS Code color theme to Dark+ (default dark).

parameters.command: SETTINGS_PATH="$HOME/.config/Code/User/settings.json"; [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_PATH" ] && echo '{"workbench.colorTheme": "Red"}' > "$SETTINGS_PATH" || (grep -q "workbench.colorTheme" "$SETTINGS_PATH" && sed -i 's/"workbench.colorTheme": "[^"]*"/"workbench.colorTheme": "Red"/' "$SETTINGS_PATH" || jq '. + {"workbench.colorTheme": "Red"}' "$SETTINGS_PATH" > temp.json && mv temp.json "$SETTINGS_PATH")

metadata.explanation: Task variation that changes the target theme from 'Visual Studio Dark' to 'Dark+ (default dark)', which is another built-in dark theme in VS Code. This maintains the same difficulty level and task structure as the original while testing a different theme option. Uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify the settings.json file contains the correct theme value.
